title: Yesterday Island and Tomorrow Island Are Under 4 km Apart
hook: Two islands in the Bering Strait are almost a day apart in time because of the date line
summary: Russia's Big Diomede and the US's Little Diomede are 3.8 km apart, yet the date line runs between them and clocks differ by 21 hours.
